description: The complete global Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) register — ~3.37 million entities across 200+ jurisdictions — with GLEIF's Level 2 relationship data resolved onto every record: direct and ultimate parents, fund managers, sub-fund links, branch head offices, reporting exceptions, and direct/ultimate children counts. Filter by country, jurisdiction, entity or registration status, legal form, managing LOU, registration authority, name and registration date, or pull portfolio analytics (registrations by country / status / authority / LOU, relationship coverage, top corporate parents). Source: GLEIF Golden Copy files (LEI-CDF, RR-CDF, Reporting Exceptions), published under CC0. Sole-proprietor records are excluded by design; every row carries its snapshot date.
name: gleif-lei-register
title: GLEIF LEI Register & Ownership — Global Legal Entity Index with Parent Hierarchies
